# Sukwana Mweemba & Partners

> Advocates and Commissioners for Oaths. Established 1992. Located at No. 9 Katopola Road, Rhodes Park, Lusaka, Zambia.

Sukwana Mweemba & Partners is a Lusaka-based law firm with over 32 years of practice in Zambia. The firm was founded in 1992 and is currently led by Mrs. Kasongo Mweemba-Chileshe as Managing Partner, assisted by Mr. Theophilus Gausi as Associate.

## Practice Areas

- Conveyancing: property transfers, debentures, mortgages, and guarantees for financial institutions and individual clients
- Dispute Resolution: civil litigation, commercial litigation, labour and industrial litigation, debt collection, and foreclosures
- Legal Drafting: commercial agreements, service agreements, trusts, powers of attorney, tenancy and lease agreements
- Advisory Services: legal opinions on banking law, company law, commercial law, employment law, land law, and intellectual property
- Company Secretarial: company registration, annual returns, company resolutions, and registration of securities

## Notable Clients

Bank of Zambia, Zambia National Commercial Bank Plc, Barclays Bank Zambia Plc (now Absa Bank Zambia Plc), Stanbic Bank Zambia Limited, Banc ABC Zambia, Eco Bank Limited, Zambia National Building Society, ZDA-Henan Guoji, Meanwood Finance Corporation Limited.

## Service Standards

Standard turnaround time for new instructions: 2 business days. The firm maintains strict attorney-client confidentiality and provides periodic updates on all active matters.
